FY27 most likely reiterated in line with GBP6.5m; small chance of a nudge up citing US momentum / Designers Guild volumes; low chance of a cut given UK weakness

findings.finding: H1 FY27 profit is the one financial line not yet disclosed, and the pre-released mix (revenue +GBP3.1m, third-party manufacturing +19%, licensing +13% with accelerated income, ~GBP1m annualised central savings completed in H2 FY26) points to adjusted PBT above H1 FY26's GBP2.2m, but it lands inside the reiterated GBP6.5m FY guide and the footnote that GBP3.6m of the GBP4.9m licensing is accelerated IFRS 15 income invites a quality-of-earnings discount.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Interim results days: +2.36% (Oct 2023), -16.34% (Oct 2024), +3.16% (Oct 2025); the H1 trading update this year moved +1.94%.
findings.why_not_priced: Revenue and the FY guide are priced (stock 79p on the update, 75p now); the H1 profit number itself has never been published and the stock has 1 analyst and ~$100k/day turnover. If the market expected a strong H1 profit the shares would not sit at an 11% discount to NTA after an in-line update; equally the accelerated-licensing caveat is why this stays small.
findings.independence: Prior interim: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/sanderson-design-group--sdg/half-year-results/9171299 (H1 FY26 adj PBT GBP2.2m, GBP1m overhead cut completed) -- same issuer, different document.

findings.finding: The board pulled the interims forward nine days, from Wednesday 21 October (set in the 7 August RNS) to Monday 12 October, two weeks after a 14% holder requisitioned a GM to remove the chair -- a board defending itself has every incentive to front-load the strongest possible results, outlook and shareholder-return message before its circular.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior date change or contested GM at SDG on record in the Investegate history (751 RNS back to before 2023).
findings.why_not_priced: The stock was flat at 74.5p on the 8 October notice and on the requisition (73p); the domestic coverage (ii.co.uk, 29 Sep) still lists 21 October, so the move has not been read alongside the requisition. If priced, one would expect a run-up into the date; 5d run-up is +0.67%.
findings.independence: Requisition RNS 2026-09-28 https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/sanderson-design-group--sdg/general-meeting-requisition-notice/9792825 and the original 21 Oct date in https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/sanderson-design-group--sdg/half-year-trading-update-/9709634 -- the inference joins two documents, nothing states the motive.

findings.finding: Closest listed peer Colefax reported fabric sales to 18 September 2026 with US +14.0% and UK -4.5%, consistent with SDG's H1 shape and pointing to continued US strength in SDG's first H2 weeks.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: SDG's last current-trading lines: H1 TU +1.94%, FY TU Feb 2026 +16.67%, Jan 2025 TU -12.04% -- current trading drives this name.
findings.why_not_priced: A peer read-through on a one-analyst name; SDG did not move on the Colefax statement. Proxy only, and Colefax is 66% US against SDG's ~37% NA brand share, so transmission is partial and SDG's larger UK exposure (-8% in H1) offsets it.
findings.independence: SDG's own H1 TU states 'trading has been excellent with a clear upward trend' in the US: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/sanderson-design-group--sdg/half-year-trading-update-/9709634

findings.finding: The Designers Guild licence (sole worldwide rights, manufactured at Anstey and Lancaster, immediate replenishment of best-sellers) is the first incremental brand volume since the period end and the interims are the first chance to quantify it or fold it into the outlook.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Announced 2026-09-25 15:54; stock 73.0p -> 73.2p that day: no reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Announced without numbers and ignored by the price; the operating company is in administration so the old revenue base is unknown to the market. Small because it is public, royalty-bearing and starts with stock-build costs, so an FY27 upgrade on it is unlikely this early.
findings.independence: Business of Home 2026-09-25 (Designers Guild in administration, Osborne & Little kept as US distributor): https://businessofhome.com/articles/sanderson-to-revive-designers-guild-brand

outside_window.finding: Requisitioned general meeting to remove chair Dame Dianne Thompson and appoint Stephen Brooke (private equity, Astara Capital Partners per ii.co.uk); board must convene within 21 days of 25 Sep and hold within 28 days of notice, so the vote lands in late October/November. Possible precursor to a change of strategy or approach for the company.
UK Autumn Budget 28 October cited by ii.co.uk as the overhang on UK consumer/housing demand (UK ~43% of brand sales).

baseline_tension: Agrees with the flat lean (+0.10) and flat run-up (-1.96% 20d, +0.67% 5d): nothing found contradicts a quiet, pre-released print; the mild positive rests on the date change and is inference.
language_note: The ii.co.uk Stockwatch column (domestic retail press, 29 Sep) carried what the RNS did not: that the requisitioner LBV Actio ties to LBV Asset Management (14.1%), that Stephen Brooke is a private-equity figure (Astara Capital Partners) with no UK plc record, Fidelity at 9.8%, and consensus FY27 EPS 6.4p / DPS 2.0p.
Everything else (pre-release, guide, licence, date change) came from the RNS itself via Investegate; no international wire or sell-side source added anything.
lessons_applied: H1 profit finding cut +0.5 -> +0.2: revenue and guide are pre-released ('a finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0') and the accelerated-licensing component is a one-off-flavoured beat ('a beat made of a one-off is sold').
Date-pull-forward finding cut +0.8 -> +0.5: inference joining two documents, not a company statement.
Colefax peer read cut +0.3 -> +0.2 (narrow proxy) and Designers Guild +0.3 -> +0.2 (already public, unpriced but unquantified).

p_up 56 -> 54: pre-released period with a guide not expected to move sits 45-55; abs_move_pct held at 3.5 (base ~3% for pre-released, nudged up for 1-analyst/$100k turnover and the live requisition) rather than cut on the reaction history.
